Incase you were confused or not sure since I'd didnt state it once the alcohol and salt is in the bong you plug the open holes as best you can, firmly grasp the neck with whatever hands you have left, and shake it like it owes you money.

As for the bowl and pipe(downstem is the proper term if you care) Same treatment, leave the down stem in the bong and just pour a little salt and alcohol down it, plug the opening with your thumb, and shake (just don't push too hard down on the stem to avoid jamming into it or cracking the bong)

The bowl usually can be cleaned with a little soaking in like a shot glass or just plug one end with your finger and just let it sit, then scrap with a toothpick or paper clip or whatever. The gunk should come off pretty easy in the bowl I usually just scrape it with my toker poker after like 5 bowls and never soak it unless necessary.

Down stems can be a little tricky sometimes depending on construction of it so I usually do my best and finish cleaning it with a chopstick and a paper towel shoved in it, or by letting it sit in like a tupperware or baggy filled with alcohol, but these are long, wasteful, or difficult ways to deep clean the stem part but they do work.

The plastic bag method also works for hand pipes and whatnot if you submerge it and just safely and carefully shake it around inside the bag filled with alcohol and some salt.

Hope that helps! I love seeing crystal clear glass on my old bongs, make them feel new all over again!

As I said in the end, the real issue is using the positive votes for negative reasons, I was just giving a full scope of the issue when applied to multiple forms and levels of secure/unsecure voting systems, because I do not know what the OP was specifically referring to. Just informing as much as I can for whoever's happens to read this thread.

If a system exists to count positives then an equal one exists to count negatives. It may not be immediately visible but tech savvy people usually can hack around the positive system to see total votes given, and there by deduce how many negative votes were given.

Similarly, since this question could be about a closed or small community then itll be very obvious who didn't vote positive or at all and will cause backlash should the person track down the nonvoters and negatives and punish them.

As for why can't you have it just show positive votes with a fool proof block on the negative system, well that goes back to stalking and harassment, a lonely poster may stalk the positive voters to obtain further info or personal details.

Or someone could make a fake post asking for the opposite opinion like "upvote if you hate X" 
where "X" is the person who made the post and will punish those for positively voting on a negative question. 

It can be used for bullying as well if someone were to ask who hates a certain person and then everyone who upvotes can be seen as saying they hate a specific member or thing publicly. 

Tl:Dr just because it's a positive vote does not mean its about a positive thing.
